list_models_on_hub: list models on the Hugging Face Hub with search, sort, filter, and limit options
list_model_files: list files in a model repository with tree, recursive, and human-readable format options
get_model_info: get detailed info about a model on the Hub including downloads, likes, and tags
get_model_card: retrieve the model card (README) for a model on the Hub
extract_model_card_metadata: extract only the YAML metadata from a model card on the Hub
